name: Formasty
tagline: Build and operate forms, quizzes, surveys, and response workflows from Cline.
description: Formasty's official hosted MCP server lets Cline create, edit, validate, publish, and inspect forms and quizzes; configure logic, scoring, themes, integrations, and webhooks; and manage submissions and exports with authenticated workspace permissions.

install.notes: Complete the Formasty OAuth flow after installation. Keep write and delete tools subject to user approval.
